name.zh: 萨斯喀彻温省横加公路 1 号

tagline.en: The first province to finish its share, five years before the ceremony
tagline.zh: 第一个建成本省路段的省份，比通车仪式早了五年

start.en: The Alberta boundary west of Maple Creek
start.zh: 枫溪镇以西的艾伯塔省界

end.en: The Manitoba boundary east of Moosomin
end.zh: 穆索明以东的马尼托巴省界

en: Saskatchewan's Highway 1 crosses the province in a nearly straight line through Swift Current, Moose Jaw and Regina, and it is the easiest 650 kilometres on the Trans-Canada by a wide margin. There is no pass to climb, no shield to blast through, and no water to cross. That is exactly why it was finished first.

It is also where the highway is most obviously a prairie road rather than a national monument. The route was chosen under the rule written into the 1949 agreements — each province designates its own route, provided it is the shortest practical east-west line — and on this terrain the shortest practical line is a very short line indeed.

The Yellowhead branch leaves the province on its own path to the north, through Saskatoon, as Highway 16. The two were not always numbered that way: Saskatchewan's portions of the Yellowhead were Highways 5 and 14 until the western provinces agreed to harmonise on 16 in 1977–78.
zh: 萨斯喀彻温的 1 号公路近乎笔直地横贯全省，途经斯威夫特卡伦特、穆斯乔与里贾纳，是横加公路上最好走的 650 公里，且优势明显：没有山口要翻，没有地盾要炸，也没有水面要渡。它之所以最先建成，原因正在于此。
在这里，这条路也最像一条草原公路，而不是一座国家纪念碑。线路的选定依据 1949 年协议中写明的规则——各省自行指定本省路线，但须为最短的可行东西向线路——在这样的地形上，最短的可行线路确实相当短。
黄头支线以 16 号公路的身份，沿自己的路径向北经萨斯卡通出省。两者并非一向如此编号：萨斯喀彻温境内的黄头公路原为 5 号与 14 号，直到 1977 至 1978 年西部各省议定统一编为 16 号。

en: Saskatchewan signed its agreement on 25 April 1950 with five other provinces, and completed its 654 kilometres in 1957 — the first province to finish, and a year after the original statutory deadline of December 1956 that no province met.

Finishing early bought nothing in particular. The federal contribution was capped as a share of cost rather than allocated by speed, and the highway as a national route stayed unusable until the Lake Superior gap closed in 1960 and Rogers Pass opened in 1962. What it does show is how much of the Trans-Canada's twenty-two-year construction was terrain rather than intent.
zh: 萨斯喀彻温于 1950 年 4 月 25 日与另外五省同日签约，并于 1957 年建成本省 654 公里路段，成为第一个完工的省份——此时距法案原定的 1956 年 12 月期限已过一年，而那个期限没有任何省份赶上。
提早完工并未换来什么。联邦补助按费用比例封顶，而非按进度分配；作为一条全国性通道，这条公路要等到 1960 年苏必利尔湖缺口闭合、1962 年罗杰斯山口通车之后才真正可用。它真正说明的是：横加公路长达二十二年的工期，有多少是败给地形，而非缺乏决心。

value.en: 406 miles (653 km) of the main route
value.zh: 主线 406 英里（653 公里）

figures.source: Canada Year Book 1967, p. 805, Dominion Bureau of Statistics

value.en: 1957, the first province to complete its section — 654 km; opened and dedicated on 21 August 1957
value.zh: 1957 年，第一个建成本省路段的省份，全长 654 公里；1957 年 8 月 21 日通车并举行落成仪式

figures.source: MacLeod, Transportation Association of Canada, 2014; Encyclopedia of Saskatchewan; Canada Year Book 1957-58, p. 836

why.en: No public figure. The per-province breakdown exists only in the Department of Public Works' 1971 final report, which has not been digitised.
why.zh: 无公开数据。分省明细仅见于公共工程部 1971 年的最终报告，该报告未数字化。

timeline.en: Saskatchewan signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement with Ottawa on 25 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 25 日，萨斯喀彻温与渥太华签署横加公路协议。

timeline.en: Saskatchewan becomes the first province to complete its 654 km section, and the highway there is opened and dedicated on 21 August.
timeline.zh: 萨斯喀彻温成为第一个建成本省 654 公里路段的省份，8 月 21 日该段通车并举行落成仪式。

timeline.en: The western provinces begin harmonising the Yellowhead branch on the number 16; Saskatchewan's portions had been Highways 5 and 14.
timeline.zh: 西部各省开始将黄头支线统一编为 16 号；萨斯喀彻温境内原为 5 号与 14 号公路。
